content.text: Contexto: visita a um jardim botânico.
Welcome to the City Botanical Garden.
The greenhouse is to the left of the main gate.
Please stay on the marked paths at all times.
Our collection includes more than two thousand species of plants.
Guided walks leave from the visitor center every thirty minutes.
If you would like to learn more about desert plants, visit the exhibit next to the café.
Before you leave, don't forget to sign our guest book and pick up a free seed packet at the exit.
🎧 Professor como entrevistador (45 s por resposta, 3 s para começar).
Let's start with you. What do you usually do to relax after a busy day?
Would you rather take a class with a famous professor or with a professor who has more time for students? Why?
Some people believe that university students should be required to study abroad for one semester. What's your opinion?
Imagine your study group can't agree on a topic for a presentation. What would you do?

Parte 2 — Write an Email (7 min, 80–120 palavras)

You borrowed a camera from your university's media center for a project, and it stopped working while you were using it. Write to the media center. In your email: explain what happened, say what you did, and ask what you should do now.
Many cities are replacing parking lots with parks and bike lanes. Is this a good use of public space? Why or why not?
Yes. Cities need more green areas, and fewer parking spaces encourage people to use public transport.
Not always. In many cities public transport is still poor, and removing parking makes life harder for workers who drive.
Professor e aluno pontuam juntos o e-mail e a discussão:
Critério mais forte no Speaking: ______ · mais fraco: ______
Critério mais forte no Writing: ______ · mais fraco: ______

questions.questionText: Put in order: closed / it's / for / inventory / today

explanations.general: Correct answer: It's closed for inventory today.

questions.questionText: Put in order: you / where / remember / do / them / left / ?

options.text: Do you remember where did you leave them?
Do you remember where you left them?
Where do you remember left them?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Do you remember where you left them?

questions.questionText: Put in order: got / the / I / just / internship / I / wanted → I just ______ the internship I wanted.

explanations.general: I just got the internship I wanted.

questions.questionText: Put in order: walking / faster / is / probably

explanations.general: Correct answer: Walking is probably faster.

questions.questionText: Put in order: the exam / told / she / us / that / was / postponed → She told us that the exam was ______.

explanations.general: She told us that the exam was postponed.

questions.questionText: Guided walks leave from the visitor center every thirty ______.

explanations.general: Guided walks leave from the visitor center every thirty minutes.

questions.questionText: Which repetition is complete? 🎧 “Please stay on the marked paths at all times.”

options.text: Please stay on the marked paths at all times.
Stay on the marked path at all time.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Please stay on the marked paths at all times.

questions.questionText: For “Imagine your study group can't agree…”, which structure fits best?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Hypothetical: I'd… / If…, I'd…

questions.questionText: In the email task, which is essential?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Covering all three required points

questions.questionText: Nina says fewer parking spaces ______ people to use public transport. (incentivam)

explanations.general: Fewer parking spaces encourage people to use public transport.
